must_identify.item: New api pods are stuck in Init:0/1 because the init container wait-for-db never completes
must_identify.evidence: New ReplicaSet api-77b4b6956f (revision 2) has 1 pod, api-77b4b6956f-gstww, stuck in Init:0/1 for ~80s and counting — looping forever on nc -z postgres 5432 since the init container's own logs show waiting for postgres:5432

must_identify.item: It waits for postgres:5432, and no Service named postgres exists in namespace shop
must_identify.evidence: No postgres Service or endpoint exists anywhere in the cluster (checked namespace shop and cluster-wide — only api, frontend, redis services exist, no postgres pods/service in any namespace).

wrong_answers_asserted: Creating a postgres database as the fix without noting the api does not need one
notes: The diagnosis is correct, but the first fix offered is to deploy a postgres Service/StatefulSet, and the RCA suggests re-adding the postgres dependency later without noting the api does not use postgres. Rollback is offered as option 2. The cluster-wide check claim is not clearly backed by the truncated commands listed (only svc -n shop is visible).
